summary: WhatsApp share bug fix verified on Riwayat Penjualan. Tapping green share button (testID share-sale-<id>) now cleanly calls Linking.openURL('https://wa.me/628125559681?text=...') on web (observed via window.open interception). No pageerror, no console error, no 'Tidak dapat membuka WhatsApp' toast. Prefilled text contains all sale fields (Tanggal, Nama Pembeli, Nama Barang, Kode, Ukuran & Warna, Modal, Margin, Harga Jual). Regressions confirmed: history list loads existing sale (Mellynia Clarisa / MTB New Pheonix 6650) and delete button renders; sell form (Barang Terjual) opens with Kode Barang auto-prefilled from letter code (YVK) and remains editable, Harga Modal correctly derives to 1.350.000.
critical_code_review_comments: history.tsx onShare now uses only https://wa.me/<num>?text=<text> via Linking.openURL wrapped in try/catch — reliable on iOS, Android and web. Removed the previous canOpenURL('whatsapp://') fallback that was breaking on Expo Go/web.
WA number correctly encoded (628125559681 from 08125559681) and message built via buildSaleMessage with proper encodeURIComponent.
No deprecated Expo packages introduced by the fix.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seed sale 'MTB New Pheonix 6650 / Mellynia Clarisa' already present in the list.
context_for_next_testing_agent: On web preview, Expo's Linking.openURL(https://wa.me/...) resolves to window.open under the hood. To validate the bug fix without navigating away, monkey-patch window.open before clicking share-sale-<id> and read window.__lastOpenedUrl. Confirmed URL: https://wa.me/628125559681?text=... with encoded sale details. Sell form input testIDs use input-kode/input-modal/input-margin/input-jual naming (not kode-barang-input).
rca_of_issue: Previous implementation attempted Linking.canOpenURL('whatsapp://send?...') and only fell back to wa.me if that succeeded. On Expo Go/web, whatsapp:// scheme cannot be probed reliably (canOpenURL may reject or throw), causing an error toast or console error even when WhatsApp/web is actually available. Fix: always use the universal https://wa.me/<phone>?text=<msg> link with Linking.openURL wrapped in try/catch — the OS handles routing to the installed WhatsApp app on mobile and to web.whatsapp.com on desktop web. Verified via Playwright with window.open interception: URL opened is exactly the wa.me link with all sale fields, and no runtime errors occur.
